description: Declare how much you delegate to the machine on ONE of your apps. Three modes. 'copilote' — nothing is autonomous: every call is a human gesture you are relaying, and everything your authority allows goes through. This is the state of every app until you delegate. 'jalons' — the machine acts alone on reads and on anything it can undo; structural decisions (graduating, stepping down) come back to you. 'autopilote' — it also decides structural moves alone. WHAT NO MODE EVER REACHES: an action nothing can undo — deleting a drop, deleting a secret. No delegation covers it, in any mode; that is what 'bounded' means here. Those are done from the cockpit, by the person who answers for them. Requires a connected account, never a management token: a token proves you hold this drop, not that you are the one answering for what a machine does next. Every change is filed, both ways.
name: dropyour_autonomy
title: Set how much this app's agent may do alone
